framework: vanilla HTML (no package.json, no build step; GitHub Pages static)

font_stack.webfonts: none (system stack only — deliberate, zero network cost on iPad)

palette.explanation_blocks: --eb-ep/ee/ept/em/ec/ei (6 semantic colours for card explanation blocks)
palette.theme_variants: html.pal-* (12 palettes) + html.cs-* (4 card schemes) — preview-only, driven by _palette_preview.js

spacing.scale: none — ad-hoc px values throughout, no --space-* tokens

motion.engines: fx_engine.js (Canvas particles, window.MecFX), study_exam.js EXAM_EFFECT_THEMES (7 exam themes), chapter_exam.js CE_EFFECT_THEMES (mirror)
motion.reduced_motion: supported — vars.css:310 global guard + JS-side guards in study.html

existing_discipline.ios_quirks: content-visibility disabled via .ios-no-cv; confirm() replaced by _tapConfirm 2-stage tap; html bg colour set to defeat iOS white-wash

notes: study.html hard-depends on study.css — any change to one must ship with the other. Colour space is hex, not OKLCH; converting wholesale would touch every file and is out of scope unless explicitly requested.
